claims.statement: For production-style 1 bp ceiling fees, no reserve-independent natural near-concavity grade bounds gross-input CPMM output even on gross inputs 0, 1, and 2.
The exact-out threshold increments for reserves (1,3) at 1 bp are 2 then 1, so gross-space jump costs can decrease.
A unit-at-a-time marginal-cost greedy allocator is suboptimal on two identical (1,7,1 bp) pools for quota 6: gross cost 6 versus global cost 4.
Valid per-pool affine output envelopes sum to a global weak-duality bound; a strict one-integer-output gap certifies exact global optimality.
The current uniform batch relation verifies uniform-price fills and aggregate k-safety but does not yet establish FM-AMM post-batch function maximization.
Within the implemented power curve family and coefficient convention, improving local slippage curvature worsens local impermanent-loss curvature and vice versa.

hypotheses.falsifier: Find a valid theorem over the production fee formula proving reserve-independent nondecreasing gross-space jump costs, or a unit-marginal greedy proof that survives C3.
hypotheses.statement: A reserve-independent local concavity or unit-marginal rule is sufficient for exact production routing.

hypotheses.falsifier: Produce a feasible allocation whose exact integer output exceeds a winner even though every envelope and strict-gap check passes.
hypotheses.statement: Fast continuous or heuristic routing can be made authoritative through exact affine or piecewise dual-envelope certificates.

hypotheses.falsifier: Show that internal crossing followed by certified net-residual function maximization cannot preserve user limits, conservation, and one canonical batch price under exact integer semantics.
hypotheses.statement: A CrossThenFM batch profile can combine low reserve movement with function-maximizing authority.

hypotheses.falsifier: Demonstrate manipulation, stale-data, replay, or discontinuity behavior that violates user limits or worsens the governed LP objective under the bounded controller.
hypotheses.statement: Lagged volatility-feedback fees can improve LP outcomes inside constitutional bounds.

hypotheses.falsifier: Exhibit a static curve profile with a proved governed objective improvement that dominates the mechanism-level improvements after integer fees, routing, and LP risk are included.
hypotheses.statement: Mechanism and certificate research currently has higher expected value than adding static curve variants.
